verdict.rationale: The CLI ships `skills init` to scaffold a new SKILL.md template and a `skill-creator` meta-skill is referenced (frontend-design/skill-creator install example), and agentskills.io provides a formal specification with a `skills-ref validate` tool, giving an agent both a template and a spec/validator to author and package a skill end to end. However, evidence doesn't show a full authoring walkthrough (e.g., packaging/publishing steps beyond init, or how skill-creator's meta-skill guides multi-file skill authoring) and community comments note confusion/skepticism about ecosystem maturity. missing for 10: end-to-end documented example of authoring+packaging+publishing a skill via skill-creator or spec, independent hands-on validation of the init/spec workflow, clearer packaging/distribution guidance beyond `skills init`.
